# jlib's components

76 components, by level. For one of them, read its declarations in the app,
`node_modules/@syware/jlib/dist/<level>/<tag>.d.ts`, and its documentation, with examples, at the installed
version: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bioleyl/jlib/v<version>/site/src/docs/components/<tag>.doc.ts`.
One missing from `dist` is newer than the installed jlib.

## Atoms

- **App icon** (`JlAppIcon`, `jl-app-icon`): An app's own icon: its glyph in white on the brand's blue, one family for every SyWare app. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/app-icon)
- **Avatar** (`JlAvatar`, `jl-avatar`): A person, a team or a bot: a picture, or initials on a colour their name picks. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/avatar)
- **Badge** (`JlBadge`, `jl-badge`): A short status, coloured by its tone. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/badge)
- **Button** (`JlButton`, `jl-button`): A button for actions, from the main one of a page to quiet ones in a toolbar. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/button)
- **Checkbox** (`JlCheckbox`, `jl-checkbox`): A box to tick, with its label beside it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/checkbox)
- **Chip** (`JlChip`, `jl-chip`): A compact token: a filter to turn on and off, a tag to take away, or a label. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/chip)
- **Divider** (`JlDivider`, `jl-divider`): A line between groups of content, across or up and down, with an optional label. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/divider)
- **Icon** (`JlIcon`, `jl-icon`): A lucide icon by name, sized in pixels and coloured by its text. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/icon)
- **Input** (`JlInput`, `jl-input`): A single-line text field that takes part in forms. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/input)
- **Kbd** (`JlKbd`, `jl-kbd`): A keyboard shortcut, one keycap per key, written the way the platform does. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/kbd)
- **Link** (`JlLink`, `jl-link`): A link in text, a list or a footer, with safe external links. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/link)
- **Loading bar** (`JlLoadingBar`, `jl-loading-bar`): A thin line that says something is on its way: nothing for a moment, then growing, never at the end. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/loading-bar)
- **Progress** (`JlProgress`, `jl-progress`): A bar that shows how much of a task is done, or that work goes on. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/progress)
- **Progress ring** (`JlProgressRing`, `jl-progress-ring`): A ring that shows how much of a task is done, for small places. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/progress-ring)
- **Rating** (`JlRating`, `jl-rating`): A row of stars to give a score, or to show one. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/rating)
- **Select** (`JlSelect`, `jl-select`): A choice among a list, on the browser's own select. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/select)
- **Skeleton** (`JlSkeleton`, `jl-skeleton`): A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is loading. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/skeleton)
- **Slider** (`JlSlider`, `jl-slider`): A number picked by dragging along a track that fills in the accent colour. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/slider)
- **Spinner** (`JlSpinner`, `jl-spinner`): A turning ring for work in progress. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/spinner)
- **Switch** (`JlSwitch`, `jl-switch`): An on/off setting that applies at once. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/switch)
- **Textarea** (`JlTextarea`, `jl-textarea`): A text field of several lines that can grow with its text and count its characters. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/textarea)

## Molecules

- **Accordion** (`JlAccordion`, `jl-accordion`): A list of sections that open under their headings, one at a time or several. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/accordion)
- **Accordion item** (`JlAccordionItem`, `jl-accordion-item`): A section that opens and closes under its heading: a disclosure, or one item of an accordion. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/accordion-item)
- **Account button** (`JlAccountButton`, `jl-account-button`): The person signed in, in the frame of an app: avatar, name and role, opening their account. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/account-button)
- **Alert** (`JlAlert`, `jl-alert`): A message in the page, coloured by its tone: a tip, a success, a warning, a failure. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/alert)
- **Avatar group** (`JlAvatarGroup`, `jl-avatar-group`): A few people at a glance: overlapping avatars, and a count for the others. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/avatar-group)
- **Breadcrumb** (`JlBreadcrumb`, `jl-breadcrumb`): Where a page sits in a hierarchy: a trail of links that ends with the current page. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/breadcrumb)
- **Calendar** (`JlCalendar`, `jl-calendar`): A month grid to pick a day, in any locale, from the pointer or the keyboard. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/calendar)
- **Card** (`JlCard`, `jl-card`): A flat surface for one subject: heading, content, media, actions and a footer. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/card)
- **Chip group** (`JlChipGroup`, `jl-chip-group`): A row of chips to choose from: one, as radios, or several, each turned on and off. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/chip-group)
- **Code block** (`JlCodeBlock`, `jl-code-block`): Source code, coloured, with a button to copy it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/code-block)
- **Combobox** (`JlCombobox`, `jl-combobox`): A text field with a list of options that narrows as people type. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/combobox)
- **Copy button** (`JlCopyButton`, `jl-copy-button`): Copies a text to the clipboard, and says so. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/copy-button)
- **Date picker** (`JlDatePicker`, `jl-date-picker`): A date field that shows the date for people and opens a calendar to pick it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/date-picker)
- **Empty state** (`JlEmpty`, `jl-empty`): What a list, a table or a page shows when it has nothing yet, and the way to fill it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/empty)
- **Facts** (`JlFacts`, `jl-facts`): The facts about one thing, label and value, the ones without a value left out. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/facts)
- **Field** (`JlField`, `jl-field`): A control with its label, a hint and an error message. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/field)
- **File drop** (`JlFileDrop`, `jl-file-drop`): A zone to drop files on or browse for them, with the chosen files listed under it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/file-drop)
- **Input list** (`JlInputList`, `jl-input-list`): A field with several values, each in its own row, added and removed. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/input-list)
- **List item** (`JlListItem`, `jl-list-item`): A row of a list: icon or avatar, heading, description, a note and trailing controls. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/list-item)
- **Load more** (`JlLoadMore`, `jl-load-more`): The end of a long list: how much shows, and a button for the next page. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/load-more)
- **Load state** (`JlLoadState`, `jl-load-state`): What a list shows while its data comes, when there is none, and when it failed to come. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/load-state)
- **Menu** (`JlMenu`, `jl-menu`): A list of actions that opens from a button, driven by the pointer or entirely by the keyboard. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/menu)
- **Number input** (`JlNumberInput`, `jl-number-input`): A number field with − and + buttons, arrow keys and bounds. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/number-input)
- **Pagination** (`JlPagination`, `jl-pagination`): Moves through pages of results, with the current page, its neighbours and the ends a click away. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/pagination)
- **Popover** (`JlPopover`, `jl-popover`): A floating panel that opens from a button: a small form, settings or details, closed by a click outside. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/popover)
- **Radio group** (`JlRadioGroup`, `jl-radio-group`): One choice among a few, all in view, as radios or as cards. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/radio-group)
- **Search** (`JlSearch`, `jl-search`): A search field that waits for a pause in the typing, with a keyboard shortcut. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/search)
- **Search button** (`JlSearchButton`, `jl-search-button`): What opens the command palette: a search field to press, with its keys. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/search-button)
- **Segmented control** (`JlSegmented`, `jl-segmented`): A few exclusive choices in a row, with a thumb that slides to the chosen one. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/segmented)
- **Stat** (`JlStat`, `jl-stat`): A key figure with its label, its change and a sparkline of recent values. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/stat)
- **Steps** (`JlSteps`, `jl-steps`): The steps of a process and where people are: done, current, and still to come. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/steps)
- **Tab panel** (`JlTabPanel`, `jl-tab-panel`): One panel of a jl-tabs: its content, and the label, icon and badge of its tab. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tab-panel)
- **Tabs** (`JlTabs`, `jl-tabs`): Tabs over panels of content: one panel shows at a time, the others a click or an arrow key away. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tabs)
- **Tag input** (`JlTagInput`, `jl-tag-input`): A field that collects short texts as removable chips. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tag-input)
- **Timeline** (`JlTimeline`, `jl-timeline`): What happened, in order, along a vertical line with markers coloured by tone. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/timeline)
- **Toast** (`JlToast`, `jl-toast`): A short notification that something happened, with an optional action, that can close by itself. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/toast)
- **Tooltip** (`JlTooltip`, `jl-tooltip`): A short hint in a dark bubble, shown when the pointer rests on its trigger or the keyboard reaches it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tooltip)

## Organisms

- **Command palette** (`JlCommandPalette`, `jl-command-palette`): A search box over every command of an app, opened by ⌘K or Ctrl+K, with fuzzy matching, and the app's own results for what was typed. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/command-palette)
- **Confirm** (`JlConfirm`, `jl-confirm`): A yes-or-no question in a small modal, and confirmDialog() to ask it with await. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/confirm)
- **Dialog** (`JlDialog`, `jl-dialog`): A modal window over the page, for a task or a decision that needs full attention. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/dialog)
- **Drawer** (`JlDrawer`, `jl-drawer`): A panel that slides over the page from an edge, for a task beside the page rather than in place of it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/drawer)
- **Flow** (`JlFlow`, `jl-flow`): Nodes joined by edges, to move, connect and extend: a workflow editor. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/flow)
- **Navbar** (`JlNavbar`, `jl-navbar`): The bar at the top of an app: brand, main links and actions, folding its links on a narrow width. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/navbar)
- **Page header** (`JlPageHeader`, `jl-page-header`): The top of a page: breadcrumb, heading, description, actions and a row of badges. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/page-header)
- **Page outlet** (`JlPageOutlet`, `jl-page-outlet`): Where the pages show: the next one loads out of sight, under a line, and shows once it has its data. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/page-outlet)
- **Side nav** (`JlSideNav`, `jl-side-nav`): The navigation down the side of an app, with nested items and a collapsed rail. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/side-nav)
- **Tab bar** (`JlTabBar`, `jl-tab-bar`): The bar along the bottom of a phone: the main places of an app, one tap away. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tab-bar)
- **Table** (`JlTable`, `jl-table`): Rows of records under column headings, with sorting, selection, rows that open on their details, formats and a sticky header. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/table)
- **Toaster** (`JlToaster`, `jl-toaster`): The corner of the window where toasts stack, and toast() to show one from anywhere. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/toaster)
- **Tree** (`JlTree`, `jl-tree`): Nested items that open and close, as files in folders, with the keyboard of a tree; loaded a page at a time for large ones. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/tree)

## Templates

- **App shell** (`JlAppShell`, `jl-app-shell`): The frame of an app: top bar, sidebar, scrolling main area and side panel, with a drawer and a tab bar when narrow. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/app-shell)
- **Auth layout** (`JlAuthLayout`, `jl-auth-layout`): The sign-in screen every SyWare app shares: the brand on a dark panel, the form beside it. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/auth-layout)
- **Page** (`JlPage`, `jl-page`): A page of an app: its header with a named back link, then its content at one of four widths. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/page)
- **Split view** (`JlSplitView`, `jl-split-view`): Two panes with a divider to drag between them, side by side or stacked. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/split-view)
- **Stack** (`JlStack`, `jl-stack`): Its children one under the other, with one space between them: the layout of a form. [Page](https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/stack)
